verdict.rationale: Factory's docs state that a designer can share a mockup and the system implements it without handoffs (factory-docs-8). Design mode lets a user select an element and say what to change, and Droid acts on that feedback in place (factory-docs-19, factory-docs-31). Live websites render beside the session for review (factory-docs-32), and tasks delegated via the App, Linear or Jira are implemented, tested and merged from a reviewed diff (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-36, factory-docs-37). However, the mockup claim sits in the agent-readiness overview (factory-docs-8), which suggests it depends on how well prepared the repository is rather than being a documented, turnkey PM workflow. Missing for 10: documented mockup/image-to-code input workflow, evidence that non-engineers can complete the flow end to end without engineering setup or review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
